verdicts.reason: A keeps the shoe-in-lime-circle motif intact and the logo, badge, headline, product and subcopy in a sensible top-to-bottom order. But there are large dead gaps above and below the headline, and the 'Full review inside.' line is tiny and stranded at the bottom. B breaks the key graphic: the lime circle is pulled off the shoe and left as a cropped blob in the bottom-right corner. The 'NEW VIDEO' badge floats at the bottom, cut off from everything else, and the subcopy is blown up until it almost competes with the headline.
